animations.notes: 7 animation types (Fade, Slide, Bounce, Zoom, Flip, Fold, Roll). Elements start with et-waypoint class (opacity: 0), Waypoints JS triggers CSS @keyframes on viewport entry, then et_had_animation class is added.

quirks.workaround: Use wrapperMappings to collapse rows/columns. Set MAX_DEPTH=20.

quirks.description: Divi outputs extensive inline styles for padding, backgrounds, custom sizing directly on section/row/module elements.
quirks.workaround: Extract computed styles rather than relying on class-based selectors.

quirks.description: #page-container is the only body child, causing probe to detect as SPA. Divi is server-rendered.
quirks.workaround: spaContainerHints drill into #et-boc to find actual et_pb_section elements.

quirks.description: Sites using Theme Builder (body.et-tb-has-template) have header.et-l.et-l--header and footer.et-l.et-l--footer. Classic Divi uses #main-header and #main-footer.
quirks.workaround: Check body classes to determine structure. Theme Builder: look for .et-l--header/.et-l--footer. Classic: look for #main-header/#main-footer.

quirks.description: Classes like et_pb_section_0, et_pb_row_3 are numbered by DOM order and change if order changes.
quirks.workaround: Use these only for labeling during extraction, never as stable selectors.

quirks.description: Parallax sections inject <span class='et_parallax_bg'> with position: absolute and background-attachment: fixed.
quirks.workaround: Add .et_parallax_bg to skipSelectors. Do not treat as visible content.

quirks.description: et_pb_gutters3 class appears on body AND .et_builder_inner_content, controlling column spacing (gutter 3 = 5.5% margin).
quirks.workaround: Account for gutter class when calculating column widths and spacing.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
